title: MM1 tutorial (small)
description: The compiled output of the mm0 tutorial file 03-mm1-intro. One sort, four terms, fifteen theorems, with a debugging index.

title: Peano arithmetic (large)
description: Peano arithmetic from the mm0 examples: 170 terms and 2723 theorems in 876 KB. Exercises virtualization and lazy decoding.

title: Fail case: reserved bit set in arg
description: An mm0 test file with no debugging index whose 56th dummy sets the reserved bit of an arg. Verifiers must reject it.

title: Fail case: index pointer overflow
description: An mm0 test file whose header p_index points far outside the file. The layout parser must report this without crashing.
